state:
This consultation compares revisions of an unimplemented DSL product, using source specifications and manually written target examples. Do not penalize the lack of compiler, libraries or infrastructure, or treat any proposal as executed. Select a useful next evaluation/correction direction rather than authorize shipping. The fictional customer operates two workspace locations:12 employees,120 client companies,600 accounts,30 rooms,100 pooled desks, with monthly 3,000 reservations,500 invoices and 300 mail items. Their steward assists software changes; business users work through the browser/chatbot. Assess the entire required workflow, allowing composed tools in one deployment and excluding unused suite functions from parity. Two causes remain after adoption/interface specialists reviewed the source.

First, imports determine more than names. Present semantics include all executable declarations of a locally imported production owner, even when importing a value contract or pure function; owner security rules, hooks and asynchronous handlers stay included. A remote-bound import includes only exported schemas and a real installed binding. Neither export nor an import grants access. The physical-mail source always imports membership owner functions/types, invoice.Charge locally, bound invoice.BillingV1, and bound std.EmailV1. Yet Service explicitly supports no linked term when paid_evidence is supplied and allows billing=false. Actual operation authorization remains mail_staff plus current employee location. Receiving requires an eligible live service; collecting also verifies the designated recipient/current delegate and item state. Forwarding requires current service, zero prior dispatch, destination_verified and an acceptable currency; Billing.charge is enqueued only for a nonnull frozen charge. Provider obligations therefore persist in the manual-payment/no-fee configuration even without those sends. Equivalent behavior must retain one customer/model authority and its guards; an unused branch cannot silently remove required installation. The existing coarse rule is simple and keeps owner behavior together. New partitions incur source references and may be awkward where workflows must mutate the same owner. A parallel Rent import of proposal contracts/derive also includes proposal adapters. Reuse provider services across modules when counting cost. Verified provider tariffs supplied by C are a $5 shared Workers minimum and$9.45 illustrative monthly email overage for W; A's economics finds uncertain setup/steward/platform/backup effort more consequential than those small bills. No dependency remedy has a measured dollar benefit.

Second, current rental reporting saves ResourcePolicy snapshots of resource settings, windows, downtime, all retained bookings and venue reservations, then locks them. quote_accept writes two such snapshots before the single transaction commits. Source time is fixed per invocation; for a report interval the largest policy sequence at the applicable effective time wins. The privileged resource_report has typed ReportBatch output, by=reservation_manager and can_work(actor,resource.location), and carries source revision plus complete/partial state. It intentionally reconstructs past saleable, booked and occupied intervals rather than relabel current rows as history. Inspection of desired JavaScript found full materialization and 55 snapshot references beyond the helper definition. Even one snapshot for each of B sequential nonarchived bookings stores B(B+1)/2 logical booking values (100→5,050;1,000→500,500); other changes add snapshots. Retention for ResourcePolicy is undeclared. This is structural growth evidence, not actual database bytes, response times or optimized compiler behavior. Equal-outcome alternatives must handle later checkout, cancelled bookings, capacity changes, timezone cuts, incomplete history and report confidentiality. Smaller evidence streams need explicitly correct reconstruction/correction semantics; a new shared feature has costs too.

composition.instructions: Rank the next correction experiment for both no-fee/manual-evidence physical mail and its integrated workspace variant. Apply the same completeness, ownership/authorization, AI-edit effort, context size and installation/version/support burden to every option. Account separately for shared platform development and adopter work. If evidence does not discriminate, select the uncertainty option.

criteria.retain: Preserve package-wide inclusion and explain every required adapter in the derived setup plan. This minimizes language and refactoring changes and keeps dependencies explicit; the focused user still provisions integrations they do not exercise.
criteria.default: Make reachable declarations the normal inclusion unit while ensuring policies, invariants and dependent trusted handlers of used owners remain present. Automatic removal could shrink dependency lists, at the cost of a more complex effect/closure specification and potential surprise omissions.
criteria.partition: Refactor with already available owning packages and explicit imports so shared values and selectable integration work have coherent boundaries. Models and canonical operations remain uniquely owned; no syntax is added. More boundary declarations, potential wrapper duplication and schema/identity migration work must be compared against setup savings.
criteria.optional: Specify one explicit optional service-binding mode, including absent-operation typing and consistent UI/MCP exposure. The single app could omit unused remote installations; configuration/version/testing complexity increases, and ordinary local imports still require a separate closure answer.
criteria.scope: Require the currently declared providers for this Mail variant and decline a standalone manual-evidence variant. Maintaining fewer configurations costs less; the unchanged requirement is then unsupported by this variant and its audience/value narrows.
criteria.undecided: Do an equal-acceptance dependency prototype before choosing. Extra investigation postpones relief but can reveal whether partitions or changed binding semantics really preserve the workflow.

history.instructions: Choose the first investigation of rental history under unchanged retrospective correctness, authorization and everyday booking requirements. Consider stored evidence/transaction-work scaling, authoring and review burden, late-event/replay/retention handling and the work required to demonstrate equivalence. Do not treat forecast performance as a measurement.

criteria.retain: Retain complete snapshots with a declared history/workload envelope. Existing reconstruction remains conceptually direct; growth still sums repeated bookings and narrowing the horizon could fail the customer requirement.
criteria.default: Write only the final same-resource snapshot per atomic operation through the existing app logic. This may eliminate redundant states at one admission time without new notation; it needs report equivalence checks and only reduces a factor, leaving growth across operations.
criteria.facts: Store compact immutable resource-policy and booking/occupancy changes with ordinary typed declarations and, if required, bounded periodic checkpoints. Less repeated evidence is plausible, but historical reconstruction, revisions, corrections and disposal need a more careful source/test design.
criteria.primitive: Specify a dedicated narrow history/checkpoint facility generated from declared owners. Sharing machinery may reduce repeated source; it enlarges language/runtime semantics for order, references, authorization and expiry and still needs a reconstruction algorithm.
criteria.scope: Serve required historical reporting through a retained external reporting/archive system while this package supports current operations. It reduces the package obligation, but leaves a paid/maintained integration and reduces replacement/ownership benefits.
criteria.undecided: Hold representation selection until a bounded logical-history study at 100,1,000 and 10,000 bookings. That costs time while leaving current growth, but avoids choosing from unvalidated representations.
